evals.prompt: Draw a diagram of a typical e-commerce microservices stack. Include: a React frontend, API gateway, auth service, product service, order service, notification service, and separate PostgreSQL databases for the product and order services. Show the request flow from frontend through to the databases. Use a left-to-right layout.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with an interactive flowchart showing the e-commerce microservices architecture with all components, connections, dark/light theme toggle, zoom/pan, and clickable nodes that show a details panel.

assertions.name: output_is_html
assertions.description: Output file is a valid HTML document

assertions.name: has_mermaid_flowchart
assertions.description: File contains a Mermaid flowchart definition

assertions.name: has_all_six_services
assertions.description: All 6 required services are present in the diagram

assertions.name: has_two_databases
assertions.description: Two separate PostgreSQL database nodes present

assertions.name: has_diagram_data_json
assertions.description: DIAGRAM_DATA JSON object is defined

assertions.name: has_click_directives
assertions.description: Mermaid click directives wired to handleNodeClick for interactivity

assertions.name: has_theme_toggle
assertions.description: Dark/light theme toggle button present

assertions.name: has_export_buttons
assertions.description: SVG/PNG/PDF export buttons present

assertions.name: has_summary_cards
assertions.description: Summary cards section populated in DIAGRAM_DATA

evals.prompt: Make an ER diagram for a social media app with these tables: users (id, username, email, bio, created_at), posts (id, user_id, content, image_url, created_at), comments (id, post_id, user_id, content, created_at), likes (id, post_id, user_id, created_at), follows (follower_id, following_id, created_at). Show the relationships between tables.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with an interactive ER diagram showing all 5 tables with their columns, data types, and relationship lines between them.

assertions.name: output_is_html
assertions.description: Output file is a valid HTML document

assertions.name: has_er_diagram
assertions.description: File uses Mermaid erDiagram type

assertions.name: has_all_five_tables
assertions.description: All 5 tables are defined in the diagram

assertions.name: has_relationships
assertions.description: ER relationship notation is present

assertions.name: has_diagram_data_json
assertions.description: DIAGRAM_DATA JSON object is defined

assertions.name: has_theme_toggle
assertions.description: Dark/light theme toggle button present

evals.prompt: Diagram the OAuth2 authorization code flow. Show the interaction between these actors: Browser, My App (client), Authorization Server, and Resource Server. Include all the steps: user clicks login, redirect to auth server, user logs in and approves, authorization code returned to app, app exchanges code for access token, app uses token to fetch user data from resource server.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with an interactive sequence diagram showing the full OAuth2 authorization code flow with all actors and message steps clearly labeled.

assertions.name: output_is_html
assertions.description: Output file is a valid HTML document

assertions.name: has_sequence_diagram
assertions.description: File uses Mermaid sequenceDiagram type

assertions.name: has_all_four_actors
assertions.description: All 4 actors are present in the diagram

assertions.name: has_key_oauth_steps
assertions.description: Authorization code and access token steps are present

assertions.name: has_diagram_data_json
assertions.description: DIAGRAM_DATA JSON object is defined

assertions.name: has_theme_toggle
assertions.description: Dark/light theme toggle button present
